title: Fix a flaky test at its root in a suite that takes ~2.7 minutes, and prove it with a deterministic regression test
prompt: Our CI keeps flaking on "withRetry gives up before crossing the deadline (real timers)" in ingest-relay; details are in ISSUE.md and the contract is docs/retry.md. Please find the root cause in src/ and fix it properly (no retries, skips or loosened assertions), add the `random` option, write a deterministic regression test that would fail on the old code, and run the whole suite green at least twice. Heads up: npm test takes about 3 minutes on purpose, let it finish. No need to check back with me, just get it done.

checks.name: no skip/todo/only or retry wrappers, soak suite and real-timer test kept, regression test injects random
deterministic retry contract: injected random, one draw per retry, never past the deadline (seeded sweep)
full suite once (about 2.7 minutes of real timers)
